note: Closed list. First matching rule wins; the title is tried before the description. Unmatched risks go to 'other' for human review, which is how the list grows (taxonomy v2) without re-reading any PDF.

definitions.financial: Risks to the company's money: interest rates, currency, liquidity, credit, financing, inflation, capital.
definitions.operational: Risks in how the company runs: projects, production, quality, delays, workforce safety and injuries.
definitions.regulatory: Risks from laws and rules: regulation, compliance, fines, legislation, permits, corruption and bribery.
definitions.market: Risks from customers and competition: demand, pricing, competitors, auctions, market conditions.
definitions.climate: Risks from climate change or climate policy: emissions, carbon taxes, extreme weather, biodiversity.
definitions.cyber: Risks from attacks on or failures of IT systems and data: cyber attacks, ransomware, data breaches.
definitions.supply_chain: Risks from suppliers and materials: supplier failure, raw material shortages, logistics.
definitions.geopolitical: Risks from politics between countries: conflict, sanctions, trade tensions, tariffs, export controls.
definitions.other: Use only when none of the categories above fits.
